image_description: A person in a blue protective suit and helmet is crouching on concrete stairs. To the right of the person, there is a modern railing system consisting of vertical metal posts and glass panels or thin cables, following the incline of the stairs. In the foreground left, a large white curved object (possibly part of a vehicle or structure) obscures part of the view. The background shows trees and a building.
